description: Held-out discovery set. Written after the tuned set (discovery-eval.json) was frozen and NOT used to tune aliases, weights or thresholds: servers are realistic catalog neighbors (github/gitlab/bitbucket, mysql/postgres/sqlite, s3/gcs/azure-blob, datadog/newrelic/prometheus, ...) and queries are phrased the way a user would, including near-duplicate and adversarial cases. Report its numbers next to the tuned set; never fit the ranker to it.
